shared_elements: paired round/circular elements on upper torso
central circular disc or medallion on torso
horizontal or curved bands across the torso
justification: Both show a vertically oriented, frontal anthropomorphic idol-like figure with a face above a decorated torso, including paired circular elements and a central round motif arranged symmetrically. The biggest difference is that A is a sparse, highly schematic torso/head with simple incised bands and discs, while B is a densely filled standing figure with explicit limbs, hands, headdress, flanking/stacked figures, and elaborate zoomorphic or scroll ornament.
